projects.title: Kinetic Type Promo
projects.description: A punchy title sequence built around expressive type and smooth easing.
projects.brief: Create a short launch promo for a fictional creative festival. Make the event name readable in the first two seconds, then use shape, rhythm, and transitions to build energy.

projects.title: Studio Product Film
projects.description: A polished product reveal focused on materials, lighting, and camera movement.
projects.brief: Stage a fictional desk accessory as a premium product. Use a restrained material palette, a soft key light, rim separation, and one deliberate camera move.
outcomes: Shape a three point light setup

projects.title: Brand Social Kit
projects.description: A compact launch identity with a considered palette and flexible layouts.
projects.brief: Design a small social launch kit for a fictional plant shop. Establish type and color rules, then carry them across a square post and a story layout.
outcomes: Adapt a layout to a second format

projects.title: Short Film Edit
projects.description: Shape a short story using footage selection, sound, pacing, and color.
projects.brief: Cut a 20 second travel moment from a supplied set of clips. Start with a clear beat, refine the timeline, layer natural sound, and finish with a consistent grade.
